rows.ARS:
Pink blend Miniature.
Registration name: MORkay
Exhibition name: Kayla
rows.Origin: Bred by Ralph S. Moore (United States, 1994).
rows.Bloom: Pink blend. Mild fragrance. 15 to 25 petals. Average diameter 2". Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Can be grown in the ground or in a container (container requires winter protection).
rows.Notes: Sequoia Nursery says this rose blends into softer shades of pink as the flowers mature... exhibition quality and good as cut flowers..
